candidates.title: Urban rail awards communications maintenance contract
candidates.search_snippet: The urban rail operator awarded a communications maintenance contract denominated in local currency.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic award notice. The urban rail operator awarded a communications maintenance contract for a defined network segment. The notice reports the original amount as KRW 2,800,000,000 and describes the equipment scope, service term, and award action; it gives no reliable exchange-rate basis.

contract_notes: Without reliable conversion data, USD 3M importance remains UNKNOWN and must not be guessed.
